 Starting XI: Inter Miami CF vs. FC Cincinnati

 Copy URL 
 Share on Facebook

 Inter Miami CF returns to Nu Stadium tonight to host FC Cincinnati for MLS Matchday 33 following consecutive away matches. Kickoff is scheduled for 7:30 p.m. ET. Below are the starting lineups selected by both teams for tonight’s matchup.
 Inter Miami CF (4-3-3): GK Dayne St. Clair; D Gonzalo Luján, Casemiro, Micael, Sergio Reguilón; M Rodrigo De Paul, David Ayala, Matías Galarza; F Leo Messi ©, Luis Suárez, Germán Berterame
 Substitutes: GK Rocco Ríos Novo; D Maximiliano Falcón, Ian Fray, Facundo Mura; M Telasco Segovia, Yannick Bright, Santiago Morales; F Riquelme Fillipi, Daniel Pinter
 Head Coach: Cristian González
 FC Cincinnati (4-3-3): GK Roman Celentano; D Samuel Gidi, Nick Hagglund, Teenage Hadebe; M David Douděra, Obinna Nwobodo, Evander, Gerardo Valenzuela, Bryan Ramírez; F Kenji Mboma Dem, Kevin Denkey
 Substitutes: GK Evan Louro; D Alvas Powell, Andrei Chirila, Kyle Smith; M Pavel Bucha, Brian Anunga, José Martínez; F Ayoub Jabbari, Tom Barlow
 Head Coach: Pat Noonan
